newsitem.title: USA: Republic Group Inc Q1 prices down.
newsitem.headline: Republic Group Inc Q1 prices down.

text.p: Republic Group Inc, which manufacturers recycled paperboard and wallboard, said Thursday lower raw materials costs led to lower net selling prices in the fiscal 1997 first quarter ended September 30.
Net sales fell to $29 million from $32.3 million a year ago, the company said.
But the decline in raw materials prices helped improve results in the company's recycled paperboard and gypsum wallboard segments, Republic said.
Recycled paperboard shipments increased two percent and gypsum wallboard six percent from the 1995 quarter to the 1996 quarter, Republic said.
Those two segments accounted for most of the company's net income to $5 million, or $0.47 a share from $3.2 million, or $0.30 a share a year ago, Republic said.
